    PRINT REPORT

    The Window is Open, Guns are Firing 

    Snowmaking fired up Monday evening at the summit on Tramway, Upper Cannon, Big Link, Easy Link and Missing Link. Snowmakers moved down to the lower mountain and fired up on Lower Gremlin overnight and are working to fire up Upper Gremlin, Spookie and Middle Cannon. 

    The Snowmaking Plan: Starting Monday night snowmaking temps will return to the summit and will reach the base in the early hours of Tuesday. Snowmakers plan to follow the cold and will start firing from the top down. Tonight, guns will fire on Tramway, Upper Cannon, and The Links. As favorable temps move down the mountain they will fire up on Middle Cannon to Spookie, and Gremlin. Strong snowmaking temps will stick around through Wednesday, giving us a good 48 hours to lay down a base! 

    Opening Day TBD: The weather is still too finicky to make an opening day call. I wish I could drop a date and deliver some good news. Yes, we have a great a window for snowmaking over the next few days, will it be enough? We just don't know until we get there. Hang tight Cannon Peeps. We will get you out there as soon as we can! 

    Guest Services/ Season Pass Office: Open Daily 9am-3pm (Closed Thanksgiving)
    Tuning & Repair: Open Daily 9am-4pm (Closed Thanksgiving)
    Cannon Sport Shop: Opening Friday, November 27. Hours TBD
    Cannonball Pub: Opening Friday, November 27 and Saturday, November 28 11am-5pm.

    Start Planning Your Season!

    Winter 2026-27 Lift Tickets, Lessons and Rentals are sale now! Save time and money when you buy online. 

    Now is great time to find last year's RFID card and double check your season pass verifications and waivers. Be sure to upload a photo!

    Don't forget to dig out those ripe socks still at the bottom of your bag and tune up those boards! 

    Hiring For Winter

    We are hiring for Snowmakers, Lift Attendants, Rental Techs, Terrain Park Crew and more. Working at the mountain gets you a season pass and buddy tickets, employee swag, and discounted skiing at other NH mountains. Head to the Employment Page for more details!
